Domain & Database Stack

Recommended architecture for sofiss.in or sofiss.com so you own 100% of your code and customer data without high monthly platform fees:

  • 1. Domain Name (`sofiss.in` / `sofiss.com`) Register on Hostinger India or GoDaddy India (~₹499–₹899/yr). Complete `.in` Registry KYC with Aadhaar/PAN.
